rows.TEXT:
Duke 
"We have taken the city Calebren!  Now we can raise an army that should impress Bethrezen himself!  The Calebrenians are now our minions!"

King's Guard 
"Let us finally enter the gateway! 
May Wotan be there to meet us on the other side!"

Lich Queen 
"We have finally reached Talder'sss Altar.  May the blood that hasss already been ssspilled here empower our ritualsss! 
Now, Hand me the Sssoul Dagger ssso I can begin the final ritual..."

Lady of the Lake 
"I have been using all of my powers to prevent the Clans from reaching their goal. 
The way to their goal is blocked right now, but if you kill me, you will unravel my spells and open their way for them."

Necromancer 
"Massster!  The Lady will not be of much ussse to usss dead.  We ssshould protect her (for now)."

Lady of the Lake 
"You would do well to protect me from the Clans' onslaught. I cannot stand against their might..."

Necromancer 
"Let usss protect the Lady and her troops! 
We cannot reach the ceremonial groundsss on time if the Clansss do not have their way blocked! 
(We can still assassinate her after the ceremony!)"

Lady of the Lake 
"Demons, heed my warning! If you destroy me, you will help your enemies!"

Demonologist 
"We do as we please, Witch! You will serve the Legions, or Die!"

Lady of the Lake 
"You are fools if you kill me! I have been maintaining the barrier that prevents the Clans from reaching their goal.  If I die, the barrier will lift, and you will all be doomed."

Demonologist 
"My lord, we must protect the Lady of the Lake, at least until we can take Calebren city. (We can then subvert the Lady to our own purposes, and add her power to our own!)"

Dwarf 
"Sir, the song has turned to screeching! 
My ears cannot withstand much more of this!"

Lady of the Lake 
"Stop, Dwarfs! Turn your ships around and never come back!"

King's Guard 
"We do not take our orders from Lake Witches! Release the barrier, or die."

Lady of the Lake 
"You do not understand the evils you will be unleashing upon the world if you break the seal. I cannot let you open the gateway. I would sooner die."

Dwarf 
"I hear a wonderful song, My Lord! 
Full sails due west!"

Ta'Klammath 
"Do not come any closer, Unclean, or you will feel my wrath!"

Druidess 
"I believe we should heed the warning, my lord.  My skills would not suffice to protect us against such a powerful demon's wrath!"

King's Guard 
"We should leave a sentry here, so we'll know when this demon decides to leave."

Ta'Klammath 
"You have been warned. Now prepare to die!"

Ta'Klammath 
"I have been awaiting your arrival for some time.  I am at your command. 
For the Legions of the Damned, I would level mountains!"

Duke 
"Nothing can stop us now! Onwards to Calebren!"

Demon 
"There is a strange music wafting in with the north winds... 
Perhaps this is not our place, let us be careful..."

Crossbowman 
"My Lord, do you hear this eerie chant that seems to be one with the north winds? 
It is chilling me right down to my bones! 
We should not be here, this is an Omen!"

Horth'Ankh, Master Occultist 
"You should not have come.Now meet your end."

Horth'Ankh, Master Occultist 
"You should not have come here. Return to the pits from whence you came."

Horth'Ankh, Master Occultist 
"I have the Dagger, I decide when the mountains will part."

Lich Queen 
"Sssurrender the dagger and we won't force you to join our horde."

Horth'Ankh, Master Occultist 
"I will not surrender!"

Lich Queen 
"This mussst be the place. 
Give me the Dagger!  I will ssstart the ritual!"

Lich Queen 
"The path isss open! Nothing can stop us now!"

Archmage Tennius 
"With the last of my powers I bring the mountains down on you!"

King's Guard 
"It is a pity his aim is so bad..."

Ta'Klammath 
"You want me to level these mountains? 
I will do as you command!"

Ta'Klammath 
"This exertion has drained my power.  I must return to the deepest pits of Hell to rest."

Duke 
"Restl, Ta'Klammath!  You have served us well!  Now we can finally take the city Calebren!"

Lady of the Lake 
"No!  Please reconsider, do not open the gate..."

Archmage Deuxios 
"I may not have been able to contain your hordes, but I know you will fail in the end. 
I die in peace; you cannot raise me!"

Archmage Sixtus 
"I cannot damn you more than you already are, but I have divined that your doom is at hand.  I will not let myself be possessed by you demons, I prefer to die here, in peace."

Vithar 
"I feel a rumble coming from the bowels of the earth..."

Vithar 
"A new way has opened!  Let us fortify that new border and then enter the breach!"

Ashgan 
"The Earth is calling Usss!  Yesss!  But we do not want to go!  No..."

Ashgan 
"The Earth did not claim usss!  But the opening must be guarded if we are to protect our landsss..."

Ashkael 
"With all these mountains around us, we will never be able to reach our goal..."

Titannia 
"With my last dying breath I open a breach into another part of the land.  May all of you die there..."

Demonius 
"You will join me in the underworld before long.  Perhaps there I will be victorious.  As I fade, I use the last of my strength to destroy more lands.  It feels so good..."
The dragon, in its death throes, thrashes around, and hits some nearby mountains, bringing them down and opening a passage into new lands...
I'm all out of mountain gear, but maybe I still have some of the things you need...
I sell potions.  I do not blink.  I do what I am told to do.  I worship Bethrezen.
The greatest fighters of the realm have trained here too!
The greatest fighters of the realm have trained here.
Hey Lads! Are you in need of some training?
I've just finished rebuilding my store from the last war.  Please don't break anything.

Special Goblin 
"You can't kill Gogg!  You can't catch me!  You can watch me!  Come meet my buddies!"

Special Goblin 
"See?  Come meet my new friend! Ha ha ha haaa! Gogg always survive!"

Duke 
"It seems as though the remnants of the Empire that were trapped here with us after the cataclysm have all become thugs and assassins.  Pity we don't have time to subvert them... 
 
Onwards to Calebren!"

Archlich 
"Massster!  Sssome humans were trapped in this valley with usss when the mountains sssprung up!  What would the Emperor think if he sssaw his once proud troopsss as the thievesss and thugsss they are now?"

King's Guard 
"Some of the Empire's men have been blocked from returning to their lands, my lord.  The mountains seem to have become impassable.  We would offer them asylum and shelter, but they seem to prefer mugging and murdering our people."

Archdruidess 
"My Lord, our seers have determined that the way to Caelith Morreth is being kept closed from us by a powerful force emanating from the far west. 
We should investigate in that direction first!"

Arch-Devil 
"Our only way to Calebren is lost.  There is only one way for us to survive here now...  We must take the Clans' and the Undead capitals for our own before they accomplish their tasks...it will not be easy..."

Legions must take the Clans' and the Undead's capitals. 
The Clans must loot Caerlith Morreth. 
The Undead must visit Talder's Altar.

Arch-Devil 
"We have stopped the Clans and the Undead!  With the power we now have and the forces we now control, nothing, not even the mountains, can stand in our way!"

Archdruidess 
"My lord, I believe the Wizard Tennius has the power to help us.  He lives north of here in the mountains.  Be careful though, he is very powerful!"

Arch-Devil 
"My lord, there is a wizard who lives north of here, in the mountains.  His name is Sixthar, and he is very powerful.  We should try to enlist or subvert him to our cause..."

Archlich 
"Massster!  I feel a powerful sssource of magic to the sssouth-eassst!  The Wizard Deuxioss has become very powerful of late...  We ssshould get to him before the enemy doesss..."

Abyssal Devil 
"We were destined to conquer the backward Dwarves north of here...  You have tipped the balance in their favor, you fools! Maybe we should not have rebelled against the Legions so soon..."

Primitive Dwarf 
"You bad people.  You make demons win.  We go, but will come back.  We want kill all demons.  Demons have fire in eyes, but we not afraid.  We go to sleep now... cold..."

Ta'Klammath 
"Do not come any closer, Unclean, or you will feel my wrath!"

Initiate 
"This demon is not worth our attention, master, let us leave it alone on its island.  Perhaps, when it finally dies, it can become useful to us."

Wraith 
"Yesss.  We have more pressssing mattersss to attend to."

Lich Queen 
"It ssseemsss that the Clans have found the Soul Dagger before we could.  We ssshall need to hunt them down and find it if we are to accomplish our aimsss..."

Lich Queen 
"It ssseemsss that the Legionsss have found the Soul Dagger before we could.  We ssshall need to hunt them down and find it if we are to accomplish our aimsss..."

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.
